places.name: The National Libyan Museum

desc.en: The Red Castle Museum, also known as As-saraya Al-hamra Museum, the Archaeological Museum of Tripoli or Jamahiriya Museum, is a national museum in Libya.
desc.es: El Museo del Castillo Rojo o bien el Museo Assaraya Alhamra es el museo nacional de Libia.

places.admission: Security conditions in Libya are unstable; check your government's current travel advice before going.

places.name: Islamic Museum of Tripoli

desc.en: The Islamic Museum of Tripoli is a proposed museum of Islamic culture that was built under the support and patronage of Saif al-Islam Gaddafi in Tripoli, Libya.
desc.es: Museo de arte e historia islámicos en Trípoli.

places.admission: Security conditions in Libya are unstable; check your government's current travel advice before going.

places.name: Germa Museum

desc.en: The Germa Museum is an archaeological museum located in Fezzan, Libya.
